[b][u]The situation at the two lower islands[/u][/b]
As the Nordiheimian navy ships was guarding the rescue operation of the desperate Argossian tribal people on the two lower island the HQ of Nordiheims command would mull over a difficult question, what to do now that the two islands was in such desperate condition and covered in poison?
Any offensive that would be done on the islands would have to deal with this fact without question as it would potentialy remain in the water and on plants to be a lingering treath, not joust for any troops they could send, but for what ever remained of the Argossian militias.

It was decided to tell the Argossians to abandone the two islands entierly for now to preserve what they had left, the islands could be taken back at a later time when conditions were better, and hopefully when the civil war was over it could be cleansed of any lingering poison and its effect and the islands restored.

new orders was also given to the air assets to keep an eye on the waters around the islands and towards the main islands that the UDF and PDF had their main bases of operation incase they did any large moves.
AWAC and reconnaissance would also be signaled to get into position for them to be added to both fleets and points of importance, things was getting more "hot" that was originaly expected.

The fleet would leave to sail back to the island of Laguz ones both the Argossian civilian and remaining military troops were safely onboard Nordiheims ships, leaving only a small and fast fleet element consisting of the resuplied 6 Loki-class stealth corvetes to keep an eye on the islands and the UDF troops there together with the two stealth observation UAVs were one would keep an eye on the airspace and waters slightly more south-eastward direction that more UDF might come from.
